item.description:

Advanced Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This work uniquely converts residual rock-salt reconstruction on spent NCM cathodes into a protective F-enriched interphase via molten-salt relithiation and fluorine treatment. It enables stable 4.6 V cycling (80.28% retention after 400 cycles) by strengthening Ni─O bonds and raising oxygen-vacancy formation energy, offering a high-value upcycling route for spent layered oxide cathodes.

Nature Nanotechnology | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This study reveals that multiscale stereochemistry—atomic-scale distortion and nanoscale short-range ordering—governs potential hysteresis in Li||DRX cells. Redox-inactive d0 transition metals, via the pseudo Jahn–Teller effect, weaken Ni–O charge transfer and enhance lattice oxygen redox reversibility. This insight enables rational design of DRX electrodes with reduced hysteresis and improved energy efficiency.

این مرور چارچوبی از واکنش تا دستگاه برای باتری‌های آبی روی-گوگرد ارائه می‌دهد و طراحی کاتد، الکترولیت، جداکننده و آند را یکپارچه می‌کند.
Small | ⭐ Review
💡 This Review introduces a reaction-to-device framework for aqueous zinc-sulfur batteries, linking sulfur conversion chemistry to system-level integration. It evaluates cathodes, electrolytes, mediators, membranes, and zinc interfaces collectively, plus flexible and pouch configurations. This holistic perspective establishes design and benchmarking principles, addressing component interdependence that isolated optimization misses, thereby advancing zinc-sulfur batteries toward safe, economical, scalable energy storage.
🏷 zinc-sulfur battery · aqueous electrolyte · sulfur conversion · device integration · redox mediator

item.title: Fire‐Safe Hierarchical Solid Polymer Electrolytes Enabled by Dual‐Functional Microcapsules for Lithium Metal Batteries
item.description:
الکترولیت پلیمری جامد سلسله‌مراتبی با میکروکپسول‌های دوکاره برای باتری لیتیوم فلزی، با رهایش عامل آتش‌خاموش‌کننده و تشکیل لایه محافظ، ایمنی حرارتی و رسانایی یونی 0.64 mS cm−1 را فراهم می‌کند.
Advanced Science | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 This work introduces dual-functional microcapsules that integrate fire suppression into solid polymer electrolytes. Upon heating, they release a fire-extinguishing agent and form a protective char layer, while maintaining high ionic conductivity (0.64 mS cm⁻¹) and a 4.6 V stability window. This offers a viable strategy for safer lithium metal batteries with thermally triggered fire suppression.
🏷 solid polymer electrolyte · lithium metal battery · fire-safe microcapsule · dendrite suppression · thermal runaway
